Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initiates a loop by instructing the WebSurfer to verify the middle name across specific external sources (Britannica, Biography.com, IMDb) without first synthesizing the existing Wikipedia evidence. The Subtask Name: Identify the actress playing Bobbi Bacha in Suburban Madness
Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: Sela Ward
Evidence: WebSurfer searches confirm Sela Ward is the actress playing Bobbi Bacha in Suburban Madness based on Wikipedia and IMDb results.

The Subtask Name: Determine Sela Ward's middle name from Wikipedia
Step Range: 3-10
The Oracle: Ann
Evidence: WebSurfer opens Sela Ward's Wikipedia page which lists her full name as "Sela Ann Ward", indicating the middle name is Ann.

The Subtask Name: Verify Sela Ward's middle name across additional credible sources
Step Range: 11-21

Evidence: Planner repeatedly instructs WebSurfer to check Britannica, Biography.com, and IMDb for Sela Ward's middle name, but WebSurfer repeatedly opens the same Wikipedia page instead of the requested sources, creating a loop of redundant actions without gathering new verification data.
